elements.label: Mystery of the Worm
elements.description: "I shall be as pervasive as a worm."

elements.label: Revenant Army
elements.description: An army belonging to no faction. All dead things belong to them, and all living things are their prey. [Enemy units of this faction will attack any non-Revenant unit, and any human unit killed by the Revenant Army will be converted into a Revenant soldier.]

elements.label: Unassailable
elements.description: Extremely powerful. [This enemy cannot be weakened.]

elements.label: Damaged Armor
elements.description: Armor dented, tracks broken, engine belching black smoke—it's a mystery how it still drives normally. [You cannot pierce what has already been pierced.]

elements.label: Spirit Fire
elements.description: "Fire, fire, Lord! Fire will burn my soul!" — Langston Hughes, "Fire" [When a unit with this aspect acts, there is a chance to produce 'Wildfire'.]

elements.label: The End of All
elements.description: The conflict here burns in another way—it no longer intensifies, but consumes us entirely. [Long-lived ones will not appear, but 'Dwelling in the Wild' and 'Dim Days' will accompany the battlefield.]
elements.comments: Remember to create long.block; this does not actually prevent the appearance of long-lived ones!

elements.label: Disintegration
elements.description: Self-destruction is possible at any moment. [Each time this unit acts, there is a chance to destroy itself, injuring allies, and producing 'Wildfire'.]

elements.label: Revenant Army Officer
elements.description: Something closest to the core among the army of the dead. Under its gaze, all 'dead' things become soldiers of this terrifying host. [All human corpses and mechanized wreckage on the field will be converted into Revenant units; the Painful Dead, Enemy Hunters, and Conscripted units on the field will also obey the Revenant Officer.]

elements.label: Impact
elements.description: This enemy's attacks are difficult to stop. [When an attack is defended against, the defender's allied unit will definitely be injured.]

elements.label: Exploitable Opening
elements.description: Now we have a chance to rid ourselves of this terrifying presence, at least temporarily.

elements.label: Threshold: Forge and Winter
elements.description: If I wish to use Forge and Winter to deal with this threat, I will need this much—but perhaps I have other strategies available.

elements.label: Threshold: Knock and Winter
elements.description: If I wish to use Knock and Winter to deal with this threat, I will need this much—but perhaps I have other strategies available.

elements.label: Threshold: Edge, Forge and Winter
elements.description: If I wish to deal with this threat, I need sufficient Edge, supplemented by Forge and Winter. Unfortunately, there is no other option. [You need full Edge and at least half of Forge and Winter to meet this threshold.]

elements.label: Weakness: Lantern and Knock
elements.description: Suppress it with the mercilessness of Lantern, banish it with the door of Knock—this is the only way we can rid ourselves of this terrible presence, even if only temporarily! [This threshold cannot be used for defense or passing; it can only be used for attack.]
